resources.string: Mink previews the date and time before opening your calendar. Calendar phrases are interpreted on this device and are never sent to us.
This calendar language is not supported yet.
Mink found date or time wording it could not safely understand.
This date can be interpreted more than one way.
The phrase contains more than one date, time, or duration.
This local time does not exist because the clock changes then.
This event is in the past.
This time occurs twice because the clock changes then.
The + command now previews the exact title, date, time, and duration Mink will send to your calendar app.
Invalid, conflicting, or unsupported date wording asks for review instead of quietly creating an event today.
Calendar phrases automatically follow the language selected in Launcher settings.
Mink uses deterministic language modules inside the app. Calendar phrases are not uploaded or sent to an AI service.
